title: Covariance on a product space
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set with probability mass function $\pi$, let $n$ be a natural number, and let $f,g:\Omega^n\to\mathbb R$. Their covariance under the product probability distribution $\pi^{\otimes n}$ is $\mathbb E_{x\sim\pi^{\otimes n}}[(f(x)-\mathbb E_{u\sim\pi^{\otimes n}}f(u))(g(x)-\mathbb E_{v\sim\pi^{\otimes n}}g(v))]$.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
